item.title: Perplexity walks away from ads to differentiate from OpenAI and Google
item.description: The company quietly phased out sponsored content late last year, ending an experiment that began in 2024 when labeled promotions occasionally appeared beneath chatbot responses. item.description: Mozilla recently confirmed that Firefox support on Windows 7 will soon come to an end.
